desc: Decomposition: F(x) = (#numbers with a zero digit ≤ x) + (#all-nonzero beautiful ≤ x); answer F(r)-F(l-1).
Precompute `need[s]` (capped 2/3/5/7 exponents, None if s has a prime >7) and domination tables `freeD[k][sum]`.
Implement Z(x) (all-nonzero count), B[m] (length-m all-nonzero beauties), and count_up_to with first-smaller-nonzero-digit enumeration, zero-digit break, and tight last-step test.
Cache all tables behind `Solution._cache` (built once lazily) so repeated prefix calls are cheap.
Verify samples and discriminators by hand-trace: count_up_to(9)=9, (15)=10, (20)=11, (99)=24; examples yield 2 and 10 as required.
Confirm deliverable: `Solution.beautifulNumbers(l,r)` self-contained, harness guarded by `__main__` so it does not run on import.
